en.title: Flip Cells to Make Every Row and Column a Palindrome
en.description:
Each operation flips one B/W cell. Make every row and every column read the same forwards and backwards, and find the minimum number of flips. The input uses uppercase B/W throughout.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, solution, and tests.
en.input: This site's ranges: the first line contains N M (1..500), followed by N lines each with M characters B/W.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation:
Example 1: the two cells must match, so flip either one; the answer is 1.

Example 2: the four corners belong to the same group, with two B and two W, so at least 2 cells must be flipped.

Example 3: every row and column is already a palindrome, so the answer is 0.
hints: Each cell belongs to the same group as its horizontal and vertical mirror images. Every group must become all B or all W, so flip the color that has fewer cells.
